body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Milan, Italy. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 1 km. It starts at Pinacoteca di Brera, Via Brera, 28. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Pinacoteca di Brera. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This in-app audio tour with an entrance ticket will guide you through the Pinacoteca di Brera and its must-see masterpieces!
>
> The tour begins outside the Palazzo di Brera. The Pinacoteca's architecture itself is a work of art, providing a harmonious backdrop to the masterpieces it houses. As you step into the palace's courtyard—a beautiful medieval cloister for the former monastery—you will see and learn who shaped this world heritage art treasury.
>
> Inside the gallery, you'll be transported into a world of artistic brilliance. The Pinacoteca's exceptional collection features masterpieces by some of the greatest artists in history, including Tintoretto, Raphael, Caravaggio, Rubens, and many more. With the informative audio commentary, you'll gain insights into the captivating stories behind the works of art that the world admires. You will witness how the art interweaves with history.
>
> While the majority of the artworks at the Brera Art Gallery belong to earlier periods, there is also a noteworthy section dedicated to the art of the 20th century, including works by Pablo Picasso.
>
> The tour will end at the Botanical Garden of the Brera, a part of the Palazzo di Brera, and a a verdant escape amidst an urban landscape.
>
> Note! This tour is not affiliated with the Pinacoteca di Brera but is provided by an independent creator. The ticket is included for customers' convenience at no charge.
